svg.metadata: {"id": "s008", "name": "计算机房", "cat": "校园", "tags": ["信息科技", "编程", "数学", "科学"], "desc": "整洁的计算机房：前方投影幕布展示积木编程，两侧电脑桌上显示器、精确键盘与鼠标，蓝色转椅。", "stand": {"ground_y": 910, "x": [600, 1320]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "wall", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "ceiling", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.1, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "floor", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "screen", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "sparkle", "enter": "pop", "delay": 1.2, "loop": "twinkle", "depth": null}, {"name": "desks_left", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.55, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "desks_right", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.65, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "screen_glow", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "extras", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.85, "loop": null, "depth": null}], "palette": {"wall1": "#EEF1FB", "wall2": "#DCE3F5", "dado": "#B9C6EA", "floor1": "#C9D2E6", "floor2": "#AEB9D3", "screen": "#FFFFFF", "case": "#3B4256", "case2": "#2C3243", "desk": "#F7F8FC", "desk2": "#DCE1EE", "mon": "#2E3448", "mon2": "#4A5370", "scr1": "#5EA8F5", "scr2": "#8E7CF0", "key": "#FFFFFF", "key2": "#C7CEDD", "kb": "#E4E8F2", "chair": "#5B8DEF", "chair2": "#4672CF", "blk1": "#8E6CF0", "blk2": "#FFAB3D", "blk3": "#59C0E8", "blk4": "#5CCB7A", "blk5": "#F06C9B", "light": "#FFFFFF", "leaf": "#5FAE74", "leaf2": "#9ED38C", "pot": "#FFFFFF", "cable": "#6A7390"}}
